lead.zh: 哥伦比亚发布方把这次访谈归纳为逆向投资、纪律和 Baupost 的建立。以下是基于节目说明的提纲，完整音频可以在本站收听。
lead.en: Columbia’s description frames this interview around contrarian investing, discipline and building Baupost. This guide uses the show notes; audio is available here.

paragraphs.zh: 节目围绕克拉曼的投资方式展开。阅读重点不是单纯反对多数人，而是考察不同判断究竟由什么事实支持。
paragraphs.en: The episode explores Klarman’s approach. Examine the evidence supporting a differing judgment rather than treating opposition itself as insight.

paragraphs.zh: 发布方突出投资纪律。理解一项纪律，需要同时看它限制什么行动，以及面对压力时是否仍能够执行。
paragraphs.en: The description emphasises discipline. Ask what actions a rule restrains and whether it survives pressure.

heading.en: Put the approach into an organisation

paragraphs.zh: 访谈也回顾 Baupost 的建立。可以把人的判断方法与机构长期运行所需要的安排分开观察。
paragraphs.en: The interview also covers Baupost’s creation, inviting separate examination of individual judgment and the arrangements needed for an enduring organisation.
